agreed: Owner, 18 November 2026: OFFICE UPDATE (master blueprint section 66, 66.2 LynkAcc). Built in section 4 step D1. No price changes (the Pro and Max top-up was done in v0.48.0).
rule: LynkAcc's rules, read only through core/books.py and ts/src/books.ts (python3 tools/books_vectors.py after a change). Money is integer minor units of one currency; rates are integer basis points (1% = 100) or integer fractions; quantities are integer thousandths. Every worked-out amount is split so the parts add up exactly to the whole, rounding half away from zero. The journal is the event log's projection (core/accounts.py with contract/chart-of-accounts.v2.json): these rules decide what is posted and when, never a second ledger. Money moves only through the licensed provider and only when it confirms; LynkOmni never holds funds. Tax rules and official layouts come from the country pack and stay unconfirmed until a local accountant confirms them.

rounding.rule: Amounts are split so the parts add up to the whole: the remainder goes to the last part of a schedule, the first parts of an even split.

dimensions.rule: Any entry line may carry these tags; reports for each read the same journal. A fund tag on a restricted fund may only be spent for the fund's purpose.

bills.approval_rule: Steps by amount (and by department where the owner sets its own steps); the person who entered a bill never approves it; a step's stand-in approves only while the approver is away.

match.rule: A bill line is checked against its purchase order and the goods received in LynkStock before payment; the owner may allow a price tolerance.

early_discount.rule: An early-payment discount is a fixed number of basis points if paid within its days; the saving is shown before the payment run.

payment_run.rule: Many approved bills paid in one approved run through the licensed provider, or a payment file for the bank where no connection exists. Each bill is paid only when the provider confirms.

expenses.mileage_rule: Distance in thousandths of a kilometre times the rate per kilometre from the country pack (or the owner's lower rate).
expenses.allowance_rule: Days times the daily allowance from the country pack.
expenses.card_rule: LynkVCard spending is matched to a receipt of the same amount within 3 days; a spend with no receipt is flagged to the person, then the approver.

assets.rule: Yearly loss of value by the method the country pack allows; the schedule ends exactly at the value left at the end; a sale or write-off removes the cost and the loss so far, and a gain or loss is posted.

loans.rule: Equal monthly payments from the yearly rate; each month's interest is worked out on the balance; the last payment clears the balance exactly. A zero rate splits the loan evenly.

closing.rule: Nothing posts on or before the lock date; a year-end close moves the year's profit into profit kept from earlier years; opening balances come from the close.

two_person.rule: A sensitive entry is prepared by one person and approved by another; the preparer can never approve their own; every change keeps its history.

repeat.rule: A repeating entry is posted on each date; a month-end date stays at the month's end; a reversing entry is posted again, mirrored, on the first day after.

bank.rule: A statement line matches one book item of the same amount within 3 days, a matching reference first; matching rules may name the account for lines that repeat; every bank and mobile-money balance is on one screen; cheques wait in their own account until they clear.

tax.rule: Several taxes on one line. A sales or import tax is added to the line (or taken out of an included price); tax held back is worked out on the line before tax and taken off what the customer pays; under the reverse charge the buyer accounts for the tax, so it is recorded on both sides and not paid to the seller. Tax numbers are checked where a public register exists. Returns are prepared as drafts and filed only through a confirmed tax-office connector.

statements.rule: Full statements with earlier periods beside them, each country's official layout from the country pack, and the international standards as a mapping. The balance sheet always balances: assets equal liabilities plus equity plus the profit so far.

currencies.rule: At period end, open items in another currency are revalued at the recorded rate (an integer fraction with its source); the gain or loss is shown apart (4400, 6700).

stock.rule: The costing method the country allows; shipping and duty added to the cost of the batch they came with; cost of goods sold worked out on each sale.

group.rule: A group tree of holding, subsidiaries, branches and countries. Group books add the entities' balances, each translated at its rate, remove what they owe each other (1600 against 2700) and their sales to each other, and show the share owned by others. A sale between group entities is mirrored: one side's invoice is the other side's bill.

accountants.rule: An accountant works on a client list with review notes, adjusting entries (two people), lock dates and bulk tasks; an auditor reads only.
